title: Fix icon shape color for colored icons.
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

- Styles icon shape so as not to override icons default colour.
- Fix jagged edges on icon shape.

Resolves #<your issue id here>

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

- All the icons that support will have fill as current colour. So will use css style `colour` to override it. All icons with fill as custom colour hexcode will not get overridden. 
- Used stroke transparent while drawing background of icon shape. this prevents jagged edges.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
I'm a bit uncomfortable with this, since even it's copyright free, the icon might still have a trademark associated with it.

Is there a different icon we can use?

E.g. we could use: https://icon-sets.iconify.design/fluent-emoji/tropical-fish/

It's available under the MIT license, so we'd have to copy the license into this test file, though.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Does this need a `flowchart TD` specifier to make it a valid diagram?

```suggestion
flowchart TD
  B2@{ icon: "fa:window-minimize", form: "rounded", label: "B2", pos: "t", h: 60 }
```

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Also, ideally, we should use an icon that's available on the version of Mermaid that's on the https://mermaid.js.org/ website.

I'm guessing that might require modifying https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/0edfab104886de283ca6c4741ff1568f03670f77/packages/mermaid/src/docs/.vitepress/theme/Mermaid.vue#L87-L103 though, so it's not required for this PR.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Could we just merge these together into one block?

````suggestion
## Syntax

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Id@{ icon: "fa:window-minimize", form: "rounded", label: "label", pos: "t", h: 60 }
```

### Parameters

- **icon**: The prefix of the icon and the name of the icon, separate by a `:`
- **form**: Specifies the background shape of the icon. Options include:
  - `square`
  - `circle`
  - `rounded`
- **label**: The text label associated with the icon. This can be any string. If not defined, no label will be displayed.
- **pos**: The position of the label. Possible values are:
  - `t` (top)
  - `b` (bottom, default if not provided)
- **h**: The height of the icon in pixels. This parameter is optional and defaults to 48 pixels, which is the minimum height.
````
